mentions.name: Maxxmod
mentions.description: A browser extension that gives users more control over the YouTube interface by reducing clutter, removing distractions, and adding features the platform doesn't offer. The project has completed research, business model, competitive analysis, feature set, branding, and a full UI of 40+ screens, with the MVP/V1 currently in development and a planned Show HN launch.
mentions.problem: YouTube's default interface is cluttered and full of distractions, and the platform doesn't offer the customization and features users want.
mentions.audience: YouTube users who want a cleaner, less distracting interface
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m a Product and UX Designer currently working on Maxxmod [1], a browser extension that gives users more control over the YouTube interface by reducing clutter, removing distractions, and adding features the platform doesn’t offer.
